# stb_vorbis

Ogg Vorbis decoder by Sean Barrett, v1.22, from
https://github.com/nothings/stb (commit d14d46f6b44456eb88beac58cba833a4135d4c89),
unmodified. Public domain or MIT (see the end of stb_vorbis.c).

miniaudio uses it to decode Ogg Vorbis: libmedia compiles it into the
miniaudio implementation (src/kits/media/SoundPlayer.cpp).
